Priya G: hey team 44b quick onboarding question about device policy: i'm running Ubuntu on a personal laptop. Does Redwood's MDM support Linux? i'm worried about full disk encryption and remote wipe behavior.

Sam (InfoSec): short answer: we support Linux as BYOD for SSH/dev work but with limitations. We require disk encryption (LUKS) for access to some internal services and we enforce 2FA on the account. Our MDM pushes certs and a small agent for policy checks on supported distros (Ubuntu LTS recommended). We cannot remote-wipe personal linux devices automatically; we can revoke access and perform a selective corporate-data wipe if you use our container (we recommend using the company Docker context or `~/work` symlink).

Priya G: thanks. any docs for the LUKS check? i'm not super comfortable with disk encryption on linux yet.

Sam (InfoSec): docs: https://security.redwood.com/byod/linux-luks-check. Quick check: run `lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINT | grep crypt` or `sudo cryptsetup status <mapper-name>`. If your rootfs isn't encrypted we'll ask you to enable it before granting VPN/corp repo access. We can walk through it on a call.

IT Ops: For enrollment on Ubuntu: 1) visit https://mdm.redwood.com/enroll and choose Linux 2) download the agent: `sudo dpkg -i redwood-mdm-agent.deb` 3) run `sudo redwood-mdm enroll` and follow SSO flow. If enrollment fails post the error here or DM us with `uname -a` and agent log (`/var/log/redwood-mdm.log`).

Priya G: agent install errored for me: "dependency python3-requests not found". is that a common one?

IT Ops: yep, run `sudo apt update && sudo apt install python3-requests` then retry. If you're on a minimal image you might need `apt install ca-certificates` too.

Jordan (People Ops): @Priya G also check your training inbox. New-hire phishing sim is next Thursday 10:30 PT. Everyone should complete Security Quickstart by EOW. If Linux enrollment blocks you, we can temporarily whitelist your account for a day while we help remediate, but we prefer encryption + MDM completed within 7 days.

Priya G: what's the whitelist process look like? i have a couple of PRs that need CI access.

Sam (InfoSec): To request temporary access: open a ticket at it-help@redwood.com with subject "BYOD temporary access" and include OS, serial, and justification. Access expires automatically after 24h and is logged. We try to avoid long exceptions but will help you get encrypted and enrolled ASAP.

Priya G: ok filing the ticket now. last q: can i run docker containers that bind-mount `~`? i don't want corp data to leak into containers or vice versa.

Sam (InfoSec): don't bind-mount `~` for work containers. Use an explicit `~/work` directory that's managed by the container policy or use the company Docker context (we provide a wrapper `rw-docker` that sets `--volume ~/work:/work:ro` by default). If you accidentally mount `~` in a container during the phishing sim demo, it's fine but note that corp tooling will flag risky mounts.
